resolutionVerdicts.reason: Ran `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only origin/feat/NO_JIRA-frontend-alignment origin/main` directly: it reports exactly one conflict (tests/e2e/features/auth.spec.ts) and auto-merges everything else, including address-book.spec.ts, matching the survey's claim precisely. Spot-checked the five new cb1ca03 specs (admin-auth, frontend-auth, frontend-change-context, address-book-auth, and two a11y specs) -- all drive through existing page objects with no hardcoded /signout, session-cookie-name, CSP form-action, or unanchored root-relative path literal that the branch's changes would break; regex assertions that do check URLs (e.g. /\/origin\?change=1$/) are end-anchored only, so they tolerate the branch's SET_BASES path prefixing.

Read base (merge base), main, branch and the merged-with-markers file directly. The resolution's end state is correct: keep the branch's `.toHaveAttribute('href', pages.signOut.path)` at the conflict, take main's hardcoded-literal alternative nowhere. Confirmed pages.signOut.path resolves to '/auth/sign-out' on the branch (tsc-003) and that main independently pinned the identical literal '/auth/sign-out' after its own self-correction (tsc-004), so the two are behaviourally identical as claimed.
resolutionVerdicts.correction: One overstatement to fix in the resolution's phrasing, not its outcome: the three EUDPA-619 additions it describes as needing to be 'layered in' (the SET_BASES import, the new 'redirects the service root to the default set's dashboard' test, and the ${SET_BASES.liveAnimals} prefix on the 'allows signing into a page further in the journey' regex) are NOT separate manual edits. Reading the actual merged-with-markers file shows git's own 3-way merge already applies all three automatically, outside and around the single conflict block -- the only genuine hand-decision in the whole file is the one href-assertion line at the conflict marker itself. The resolution's target end state is correct; the amount of manual work it implies is overstated.

verdictHolds.reason: The five cluster commits genuinely merge clean (verified via merge-tree, not just asserted), EUDPA-619 (not EUDPA-333) is confirmed as the sole source of the auth.spec.ts conflict, and none of the grepped surfaces (signout, sid, form-action, address-book) turn up a new spec or changed spec that depends on something the branch changed.
